Solution 02

Agricultural Processing Equipment

Cleaning, separating and size-reduction machinery for agricultural produce.

Request a QuoteContact Our Team

01Overview

What this solution covers.

Cleaning and separation machines, breakers and degerminators prepare grain and other agricultural product for further processing. We help buyers match machines to their product and throughput and request technical data from suppliers.

Application areas

  • Grain cleaning and preparation
  • Corn and cereal germ separation
  • Plant upgrades that add a single machine

02Process information

How the process runs.

  1. 01

    Receiving

    Product enters the line by conveyor or elevator.

  2. 02

    Cleaning and separation

    Lighter material and dust are removed with air-assisted separators.

  3. 03

    Size reduction

    Breakers and degerminators prepare product for milling.
